After Rd2+ Kf1, Black has Rxc2 winning the queen. The move is clearly best—it forces either a win of the queen or a decisive advantage.

**Best move:** Rd2+

**Main line:** Rd2+ Qxd2 Bxd2 (winning the queen for a rook, +4 material advantage)

**Motif:** fork (the rook gives check while attacking the queen and bishop simultaneously)

**Coaching note for the club player:**

When your opponent moves their king to safety, scan for rook checks along the back ranks and central files. Here, Rd2+ forks the king, queen, and bishop—all three pieces at once! White must give up the queen. The winning formula: **give check with a piece that simultaneously attacks your opponent's most valuable undefended piece.**
